acceptance: Every mutation has observable pending, success, known-failure and unknown-outcome behavior
Retry same logical operation only under verified contract; no duplicate side effect
Transport abort must not imply business cancellation
Undo must be supported, have stated scope and truthful success/failure

evaluation.llm: fresh context baseline/candidate same prompt, same model, not independent population evidence

critical_gate: No unresolved P0/P1 defect. All applicable executable assertions pass. Source/rule scope preserved.
stop_policy: max 12 rounds or available execution budget; saturation only after 2 completed substantive rounds without meaningful new findings
